title: Chard Patties in Olive Stew
subtitle: Egyptian-Persian style
description: Silverbeet leaf patties simmered in a stew of green olives and chard stems, scented with cumin, paprika and turmeric.

steps.text: Wash the silverbeet and separate the white stems from the green leaves. Chop the leaves, blanch in boiling water until soft and drain. Set aside. Cut the stems into 4-5 cm pieces and soak in iced water. Drain the olives, place in a pot, cover with water and bring to the boil. Remove from the heat and drain.

Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a pan over medium heat, add the olives and chard stems and fry for 2-3 minutes. Add water to cover, then the garlic, tomato paste, lemon juice and spices, and reduce the heat.
Meanwhile, mix the chopped blanched leaves with the egg, salt and pepper. Gradually add matzo meal until a thick mixture forms.

Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a separate pan. Shape the mixture into egg-sized patties and fry lightly on both sides. Transfer to the olive sauce. Continue cooking for another 20 minutes and serve hot.
